title: Cartwise+ Membership Welcome-Back Amounts for Members Returning to Monthly
content:
A welcome-back amount is taken off the move-to-monthly charge for Cartwise+ Membership members who were on a monthly plan before, when the membership moves from Cartwise+ Annual to Cartwise+ Monthly on a pause request.

**Scale.** A membership with at least 12 renewal charges on record takes off 1.00. One with at least 6 and fewer than 12 takes off 0.50. Any other takes off 0.00.

| Renewal charges on record on the membership | Welcome-back amount taken off (USD) |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 1.00 |
| 6 to 11 | 0.50 |
| 0 to 5 | 0.00 |

## Notes

- **Renewal charges on record** are the fee charges of the renewal type on the membership, over its whole history; first-period, renewal-retry and plan-switch charges are not renewal charges.
- The amount is a fixed figure in US dollars, taken off the charge.

## Hypothetical boundary cases

| Renewal charges on record | Amount taken off |
|---|---|
| 12 | 1.00 |
| 11 | 0.50 |
| 6 | 0.50 |
| 5 | 0.00 |
